# Kenney Space Kit

Author: Kenney. Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/space-kit

Downloaded on 2026-10-03 from the creator's official download:
https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/space-kit/20874c75ac-1677698978/kenney_space-kit.zip

License: CC0. The unchanged license shipped in the archive is `License.txt`.
Only selected FBX models are imported. Their material colors are adapted to URP in
`StationBuilder.cs`. Rescue craft and generators use these meshes; the robot,
electric cells, reclaim cabinet, boarding doors and electrical strips are original
composite models created for this project. No artwork from commercial games is included.

Gameplay research: the official descriptions of Moving Out
(https://www.team17.com/games/moving-out) and Good Job!
(https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/good-job-switch/) inspired transport
route choices and replaying for a faster, cleaner result. Their assets and code are
not imported. The station story and rules are this project's own design.
